newsitem.title: USA: Alberto-Culver on target for FY97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Alberto-Culver on target for FY97 growth.

text.p: Alberto-Culver Co, after strong earnings and sales growth in its December 31 first quarter, is on target to achieve its objectives for the 1997 fiscal year, Howard Bernick, the company's president, said on Thursday.
The company previously said it expected both sales and earnings to increase by up to 10 percent in the fiscal year.
Profits from operations in the first quarter increased 30 percent and sales rose 23 percent, though Bernick said it was unrealistic to expect gains of that magnitude in every period.

"We operate in very competitive markets, and the investment spending for new products and the advertising weight that we want to put behind our brands worldwide will temper earnings growth rates later in the year compared to the excellent December quarter results," Bernick said in a statement.

Earlier Thursday, the personal care products company reported first-quarter earnings of $0.87 a share on a diluted basis, compared with $0.44 a share in the year-earlier quarter. The most recent quarter included a $0.35-a-share gain from insurance proceeds. Sales advanced to $426.1 million from $347.6 million.
